root_cause_matrix.diagnosis_basis: frozen A5 receipts, the frozen fixture payload registry, and frozen plan fields only; diagnosis-only token distribution statistics (document-frequency readouts) were computed over the frozen g021 eligible universe; NO candidate scorer was run and no selection/retention outcome was computed

A_tokenizer_granularity_insufficient.evidence: the v1 tokenizer splits the compound identifier restgas_profile into {restgas, profile}, so the plan symbol's identifier form is invisible to every signal; plan.symbols = ['restgas_profile'] exists in the frozen g021 plan but the v1 contract has no identifier-exact tier

B_query_side_token_set_too_broad.evidence: question tokens include generic items (how/is/to) and plan.concepts contributes distributed/target/simulation; with raw set-overlap counting the generic token target (df = 49/62 in the g021 universe) counted the same as rare tokens; the defect is discrimination weighting rather than the token set itself

C_candidate_side_field_set_too_weak.evidence: the fixture persists text[:2000] for every candidate but v1 used only locator path + title; prod_sim_hvmaps.C's bounded text literally contains the identifier restgas_profile (the configuration key the macro passes to PndMasterRunSim), a discriminating signal v1 never read

D_raw_overlap_count_too_coarse.evidence: raw integer overlap treats the df-49/62 token target identically to df-2/62 tokens; no rarity or normalization signal exists in v1

E_path_title_contributions_incorrectly_t.evidence: for source-file objects the persisted title equals the locator path (prod_sim_hvmaps.C's title is literally 'macro/target/prod_sim_hvmaps.C'), so v1's additive path_overlap + title_overlap double-counts the same generic directory token (target) twice, while README section chunks carry genuinely distinct descriptive titles — a structural asymmetry that inflates file-object scores with generic tokens and hands section chunks an unwarranted title advantage

F_common_query_tokens_dominate_discrimin.evidence: document frequencies across the frozen g021 eligible universe: target 49/62, readme 61/62, profile 23/62, restgas 22/62, versus supplied 2/62, distributed 8/62, simulation 8/62 — generic tokens dominate raw overlap while genuinely distinctive tokens are rare

G_candidate_title_chunks_create_spurious.evidence: README section-chunk titles are long descriptive sentences ('6.5 MC-truth control for a distributed Restgas profile') whose raw title overlap (3) outranks the precise file identifier path of prod_sim_hvmaps.C; title semantics differ across object kinds and v1 treats them uniformly additive

H_support_rank_tie_break_insufficient.evidence: 3 of the 4 g021 winners carried non-graph channel support and prod_sim_hvmaps.C had none, so the support tie-break could not separate them; role must nonetheless remain non-mandatory (g036 bridge-only candidates must keep winning) — the repair is higher-resolution primary signals, not a support promotion

I_structural_distance_insufficient.evidence: all 62 g021 candidates share one origin at distance 1 — zero discrimination inside single-origin sets; retained only as a late tie-break

J_per_origin_cap_primary_problem.evidence: the cap correctly bounded the single-origin fan-out (62 -> 4 candidates, displacement 4 -> 0); the failure is that the ranking under the cap lacked resolution; raising the cap would be budget relaxation (prohibited as primary repair) and would not improve discrimination

K_selectivity_cap_primary_problem.evidence: SELECTIVITY_CAP = 8 was never binding in g021 (only 4 candidates survived the origin cap); the loss occurred inside the origin cap boundary

L_provenance_origin_attribution_semantic.evidence: g021 has a single origin, so least-used-origin attribution was inert; the attribution semantics are not implicated by the observed failure

ranking_vs_budget_diagnosis.question: If several candidates have the same primary score inside one origin, does the current system possess enough generic information to rank them meaningfully before the origin cap is applied?
generic_information_available: plan-symbol compound identifiers exist in the frozen plan fields (g021: restgas_profile) and are invisible to the v1 tokenizer — an exact-identifier tier is available
bounded text payloads (text[:2000]) are persisted for every eligible candidate and contain literal identifier and query-token occurrences unused by v1
universe-local document frequencies are computable deterministically from the eligible universe alone (df target 49/62 vs supplied 2/62), enabling rarity weighting without any corpus-wide tuning
locator structure supports a generic basename/parent-directory decomposition (title == path for source-file objects makes the de-duplication well-defined)
ranking_vs_budget_diagnosis.conclusion: the failure is a ranking-resolution defect, not a budget defect; increasing caps would admit more low-resolution candidates without improving ordering and is rejected as the primary repair

level_1_symbol_exact_tier.signal: number of DISTINCT compound plan-symbol strings (unsplit identifier form, from the frozen plan.symbols field) with at least one boundary-aware exact match in the candidate's allowed search surfaces (locator basename, full normalized locator path, bounded text[:2000]; title EXCLUDED by the strong default because it is synthetic/descriptive and duplicates path semantics for source-file objects)
level_1_symbol_exact_tier.rationale: distinctive identifier matches are the strongest generic query-grounded signal; if plan.symbols is empty the level is inert for every candidate (generic behavior)
level_1_symbol_exact_tier.note: this is a distinct signal from the tokenizer's split tokens; the tokenizer itself is unchanged
level_1_symbol_exact_tier.exact_match_contract_repair_note: D3.5-A5-R1-R1: normalization for both plan symbol and candidate search surface is Unicode NFKC -> casefold -> path separators normalized to '/'; the compound identifier is never split for this tier; a match requires the normalized symbol occurrence to be bounded on both sides by start/end of string or a character outside [a-z0-9_] (underscore is part of an identifier); arbitrary substring matching is prohibited; hyphen forms (restgas-profile) and camelCase forms (RestgasProfile) do NOT count as exact matches for restgas_profile (no invented equivalence; ordinary lexical overlap still applies); count semantics: distinct symbols matched, occurrences and multi-surface hits contribute once; empty plan.symbols -> symbol_exact_tier = 0 for every candidate with no fallback to inferred symbols

level_2_rarity_weighted_overlap.signal: sum over distinct query tokens t present in the candidate's (basename union parent-directory union title union text[:2000]) token view of idf(t) = log2((|U| + 1) / (df(t) + 1)), where df(t) is the number of UNIQUE eligible candidate object IDs whose candidate_lexical_view contains t, and |U| is the eligible universe size (|U| >= 1; if |U| = 0 selectivity selects none and no IDF is computed)
level_2_rarity_weighted_overlap.rationale: downweights universe-ubiquitous tokens (target 49/62, readme 61/62) and upweights distinctive ones (supplied 2/62) with zero handwritten lists
level_2_rarity_weighted_overlap.bias_controls: distinct-token counting and universe-local computation only; the candidate lexical view is a deduplicated set union so a token present in path + title + text contributes its IDF weight exactly once (removes the R1-diagnosed path/title double-count)
level_2_rarity_weighted_overlap.idf_contract_repair_note: D3.5-A5-R1-R1: the originally frozen idf(t) = log2(|U| / (1 + df(t))) is defective because df(t) = |U| yields log2(|U|/(|U|+1)) < 0, i.e., a matched ubiquitous token would create negative relevance evidence. Repaired formula log2((|U|+1)/(df+1)) is non-negative on 1 <= df <= N, idf(df=N) = 0, strictly decreasing in df, deterministic for same (N, df); base 2; floating-point values are ranking-only and comparison uses unrounded values (serialization may round for diagnostics only)

level_3_basename_coverage.signal: count of distinct query tokens present in the locator basename tokens
level_3_basename_coverage.rationale: a basename match is structurally more specific than a parent-directory match; repository-generic decomposition, no directory names encoded

level_4_text_presence.signal: count of distinct query tokens present in text[:2000]
level_4_text_presence.rationale: bounded distinct-token presence (not raw occurrence count) mitigates candidate-length bias while adding the persisted text field as relevance evidence

secondary_rank.support_rank: unchanged A4/A5 role: after all primary levels, before structural distance; never mandatory; bridge-only candidates remain able to win on primary levels alone

selected_repair_design.title_handling: title tokens participate in the lexical token view (levels 2 and the gate) but the v1 additive path+title double-count is removed; for source-file objects whose title equals the path this prevents double-counting one generic token
selected_repair_design.caps_unchanged: PER_ORIGIN_CAP = 4 and SELECTIVITY_CAP = 8 preserved; budget relaxation rejected as the repair
selected_repair_design.model_calls: SELECTIVITY_MODEL_CALLS = 0; EXTRA_EMBEDDING_CALLS = 0; all signals are deterministic functions of the frozen fixture

query_side_relevance_decision: the query token set (question ∪ plan.concepts ∪ plan.symbols) is unchanged as the lexical source; discrimination is repaired by rarity weighting and the symbol-exact tier rather than by hand-built stopword lists
locator_relevance_decision: generic basename/parent-directory decomposition adopted as ranking levels 2-3; no specific directory names are encoded
title_relevance_decision: title tokens remain in the lexical view but the additive path+title double-count is removed; no README penalty; the defect is relevance discrimination, not extension preference
text_payload_relevance_decision: bounded text[:2000] is used as query relevance evidence only (symbol-exact tier level 1 and distinct-token presence level 4); it is never governance evidence, identity authority, or answer truth; no model call

decision_rationale: all five continuation standards hold: (1) the A5 fan-out architecture remains useful (62->4, 67->8, displacement 4->0 and 20->8, controls fail-closed); (2) generic additional deterministic relevance information exists and is currently unused (plan-symbol compound identifiers, persisted bounded text payloads, universe-local rarity weighting, basename decomposition); (3) the caps can remain bounded (PER_ORIGIN_CAP_NEXT = 4, SELECTIVITY_CAP_NEXT = 8); (4) the repair requires no case-specific knowledge (every signal is a frozen-field, repository-generic mechanism); (5) the repair can be fully preregistered before revalidation. The budget-architecture change was rejected because the caps demonstrably behaved correctly and the loss occurred inside the origin boundary from ranking-resolution poverty, not because preservation is systematically impossible under the caps. The stop path was rejected because no benchmark-specific scoring, budget expansion, file-type privilege, LLM judging, or unbounded weighting is required.
